recent_events.narration: The Gilded Tankard in Absalom is quiet and nearly empty, with no patrons beyond Eldric, Marta the Scholar, and Gribbles Rindsworth. Warm candlelight washes over rough-hewn wooden floors and a polished bar lined with bottles and tankards. Eldric, the broad-shouldered barkeep, stands behind the bar polishing a mug while keeping a steady eye on the room. Marta the Scholar works at a table buried in spellbooks, loose notes, and a crystal-bound codex. Gribbles Rindsworth lounges nearby with a tankard in hand, his sharp goblin eyes tracking every conversation from a seat close to Marta. Iron sconces and a stone fireplace cast steady amber light across the otherwise empty tavern.
